neighbours.label: the preposition after a fronted 'Not' or 'Only' that triggers inversion (Not since, Not until, Only in)
fire: The record was finally broken. Not since the summer of 1968 had the river risen so high.
People ignored the warnings. Not until the bridge collapsed did the council act.
The policy changed slowly. Only in 2004 was the old rule finally dropped.
Early cameras were rare. Not until the 1930s did most families own one.
The town was quiet for decades. Not since the war had so many people gathered there.
The court is careful here. Only in rare cases will it grant such an order.
The disease spread unnoticed. Not until doctors compared notes was it recognised.
The tradition faded away. Only after the festival returned did crowds come back.
quiet: The record was finally broken. Since the summer of 1968 the river had stayed low.
People ignored the warnings. After the bridge collapsed the council finally acted.
The policy changed slowly. In 2004 the old rule was finally dropped.
Early cameras were rare. By the 1930s most families owned one.
The town was quiet for decades. During the war many people gathered there.
The court is careful here. In rare cases it will grant such an order.
The disease spread unnoticed. When doctors compared notes it was recognised.
The tradition faded away. After the festival returned the crowds came back.

notes: Top: 'Not since' x2, 'Not until' x2, 'Only in'.
